reviews.comment: Hardest class I have ever taken, but also the most interesting and educational. Exams are 95% of your grade. 17 online quizzes are the other 5%. Quizzes can take around an hour each. Dye is a tremendous professor and a really nice guy.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE HIM. I had him and might not pass the class. He curves the test a good amount but being with him in class is the worst, his lectures are so boring and he doesn't make sense. Idk if I'm just stupid but I absolutely hated this class. WORST CLASS OAT
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is probably my favorite prof at Mays. I took him for 351 and I feel like I actually learned so much in his class. His lectures are very effective and he is very good at communicating the concepts of the class. His tests were difficult but if you do the practice problems you should be good. I highly recommend taking this prof.
Take this class! so much extra credit and doable exams!!! Exams are 94.5 percent of your grade but they are online and non proctored!
Amazing professor who truly cares about his students. Finc 351 is a hard class, but he is very understanding and is very straightforward on what will be on the exams.

Dr. Dye is a great professor. He lectures very well and is very caring of each student. His class is definitely challenging and test heavy but if you put in the work an A is definitely attainable. I would recommend him for FINC 351 or any other finance course. Amazing guy!

This class is far from being easy and it is not the most enjoyable class to sit through at 11AM. Dye does his best to make it fun and he truly is a great professor who cares, super easy to talk to, and knows what he is taking about. Although the class isn't the best, taking it with him is a great move

He cares so much about his students! However, this class is NOT EASY!!! His 3 exams are worth 94.5% of your total grade (worst exam worth 30%; best exam worth 33%). He's so nice and has good explanations, but sometimes can get a bit sidetracked by students' questions. Start on the problem sets WAY earlier than you think to get a good grade!

Professor Dye was one of my favorite professors that I had at TAMU. He lectures so well and wants all of his students to succeed. This doesn't mean that 351 is a cake walk though. This class takes a lot of work and studying to get a good grade in but if you attend class and pay attention you will be on the right track. I would take him again.
Best professor at TAMU. Tough class, but his lectures are very interesting and you will learn more than probably any other class in the Finc dept.

Professor Dye is the best professor in the finance department hands down. He understands how to teach students well and is clearly passionate about finance. No question is a dumb question and he is very clear how to succeed in his class.
Dye has hard tests gotta go to class to know the material as well as do well on the quizes. The class is 95% test grades 5% hw so gotta do good on tests.

Professor Dye is an amazing teacher who you can tell has a passion for finance along with making his students learn. He is clear in what he expects from students and gives a clear path to success. Exams are worth 95% of your overall grade so make sure to master the practice problems he supplies and you should succeed!

This is my second time taking this class, but this time I felt a lot more comfortable because of professor Dye. While still a very challenging course, his lectures were great and he really does well at conveying the concepts. He is also very passionate about the subjects, even at 8am! Flexible office hours. I would recommend professor Dye.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: hard class but wouldn't want anyone else teaching it
Prof Dye is one of the best professors I've had. He teaches the material with such passion and is able to make the complex subject matter understandable. Exams are long and challenging, but fair.

Professor Dye might be the best professor in Mays. He puts so much effort into making a difficult class understandable, and really cares about the students. Finc 351 is a lot no matter how you teach it, but I think Dye does it the best way possible.

Professor Dye is my favorite professor so far. He knows how to teach this course very well and if you attend class and do the practice problems you should understand the concepts very well. And if you don't he can explain it to you in an easy to understand way. He knows his stuff and knows how to teach it well. Very impressed.

Professor Dye is an incredible and extremely passionate professor. His class is definitely difficult, but if you work hard and adtually learn the material, you will be successful and you will get A LOT out of his class. His exams and practice problems are essentially puzzles that you should thoroughly understand to be successful!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Probably the hardest class you'll ever take. He's incredibly passionate about investments and preaches to students like a hip youth pastor. He would be a fun guy to have a beer with, but makes this class unnecessarily hard. There's too much information for a single semester. Cool guy, but not available outside of class which makes it impossible.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class was pretty difficult for me, but if you put in the work you are at least guaranteed a B.  He is very engaging and a passionate lecturer.  Fair grader and answers questions thoroughly.  I would recommend him over anyone else for Investment Analylsis.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He the best professor I have ever had my whole college career. He is really engaging, and his lecture is so interesting that I am mad at myself for missing one class. He answer your questions thoroughly, and even point out aspects of your own question that you never think of. I would take another class from him in a heartbeat!
